meta.name: lcx-doctor
meta.description: Diagnose LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health against the latest sources. Use whenever the user asks for a doctor or health check, says LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex behaves oddly after an install, update, or config change, suspects a stale, drifted, or broken setup, or wants the local install audited and compared with the latest LazyCodex and Codex code.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复 LazyCodex 和 Codex CLI 的安装健康状态
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果本地 LazyCodex 或 Codex 安装可能已过时或损坏
copy.tagline_en: Check and fix LazyCodex and Codex CLI installation health
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your local LazyCodex or Codex install may be stale or broken

howto.what: 抓取 LazyCodex 和 Codex 的最新源码,对照检查本地安装、版本、配置和插件,输出 PASS/WARN/FAIL 健康报告,每条结论附命令输出或文件证据;只做诊断,未经你同意不改动任何东西。
howto.when: 当你要求给 LazyCodex 或 Codex 做健康检查,提到 LazyCodex、lazycodex-ai、omo-codex 等词,或感觉 Codex 在安装、更新、改配置后行为异常时触发。

say.text: 帮我诊断一下 LazyCodex 的安装健康吗?
say.note: 它会拉取最新源码并给出报告。

say.text: 我刚升级了 Codex,现在有点不对劲,查查哪里出问题了。
say.note: 会检查配置和插件并定位偏差。

say.text: 把本地 LazyCodex 和最新源码对比,给我一份检查报告。
say.note: 报告会标注每项结论的证据。

howto.what_en: Fetches latest LazyCodex/Codex sources, audits your local install, config, and plugins, and returns a PASS/WARN/FAIL report with evidence per verdict. Diagnosis only; it won't mutate your install without your explicit go-ahead.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a doctor/health check, mention LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, or Codex acts oddly after install/update/config change.

say_en.text: Help me check if my LazyCodex install is healthy.
say_en.note: It syncs latest sources and gives a report.

say_en.text: I just upgraded Codex and it feels off—find what's wrong.
say_en.note: It checks config and plugins for drift.

say_en.text: Compare my local LazyCodex with the latest source and report.
say_en.note: Each verdict in the report cites evidence.
